company.name: Feather
company.shortDescription: Feather is an online furniture rental startup that designs and manufactures all pieces of furniture and home decor available for rent.
company.description:
Feather provides furniture and home decor rental service

The company helps city dwellers to furnish their homes without spending a fortune or hurting the planet in the process. Members of Feather have access to high-quality furniture at a low monthly price with the option to add, swap, buy, or return when life or tastes change. Furniture is delivered and assembled for free within a week. Feather’s circular approach reduces the environmental impact that furniture waste has on the planet by keeping furniture in homes and out of landfills.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,821,194 to $348,889,003, a 123.67x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 65 (-5 over 90 days) and market heat at 55 (-8).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
